# Medical Council of New Zealand

> The regulatory authority for medical practice in New Zealand, setting standards for doctor conduct, registration pathways, and professional competence.

The Medical Council of New Zealand (Te Kaunihera Rata o Aotearoa) regulates medical practitioners and establishes standards for professional practice. The site provides guidance on registration, recertification, professional conduct standards, and support for both doctors and patients navigating the medical regulatory system.

## Key Topics

- Medical registration
- Registration pathways
- Vocational (specialist) registration
- Cultural competence and safety
- Hauora Māori
- Professional conduct standards
- Practising certificates
- Recertification and professional development
- International medical graduates
- English language requirements
- Fitness to practise
- Medical ethics
- Doctor-patient boundaries
- Consultations and feedback
- Health Practitioners Competence Assurance Act 2003

## Medical Registration & Pathways

- [How to register](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/registration/getting-registered/how-to-register): Comprehensive guide to medical registration process and available pathways in New Zealand.
- [Registration pathways](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/registration/getting-registered/registration-pathways): Overview of three main medical registration scopes and their specific application pathways.
- [Types of vocational scope](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/registration/scopes-of-practice/vocational-and-provisional-vocational/types-of-vocational-scope): Reference of 36 specialist medical scopes and their training programme structures.
- [Fast-track registration for provisional vocational (specialist) registration](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/about-us/news-and-updates/fast-track-registration-for-provisional-vocational-specialist-registration): Announcement of new fast-track specialist registration pathway for international medical graduates.
- [English language requirements](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/registration/getting-registered/registration-policy/english-language-requirements-2): Policy defining English language proficiency standards for medical registration.

## Professional Standards & Conduct

- [Unprofessional behaviour](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/our-standards/current-standards/unprofessional-behaviour): Standard defining professional conduct expectations and obligations for registered doctors.
- [Sexual boundaries](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/our-standards/current-standards/sexual-boundaries): Standard on maintaining professional sexual boundaries in doctor-patient relationships.
- [Treating yourself and those close to you](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/our-standards/current-standards/treating-yourself-and-those-close-to-you): Standard on conflict-of-interest principles for self-treatment and family care.
- [Resource constraints](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/our-standards/current-standards/resource-constraints): Ethical guidance for doctors managing clinical prioritisation in resource-limited settings.
- [Chaperones](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/our-standards/fitness-to-practise/chaperones): Policy on chaperone requirements for doctors with fitness-to-practise concerns.

## Recertification & Professional Development

- [Regular practice review and collegial practice visits](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/registration/maintain-or-renew-registration/recertification-and-professional-development/regular-practice-review): Guide to Regular Practice Review requirements for ongoing doctor competence and professional development.
- [Policy on practising certificates](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/registration/getting-registered/registration-policy/policy-on-practising-certificates): Policy governing practising certificate requirements and rules for medical practice.

## Cultural Competence & Hauora Māori

- [Consultation – Draft statements on cultural competence, cultural safety, and hauora Māori](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/about-us/consultations/consultation-draft-statements-on-cultural-competence-cultural-safety-and-hauora-maori): Public consultation on draft standards for cultural competence and safety in medical practice.
- [Guidance on using artificial intelligence in patient care](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/about-us/news-and-updates/guidance-on-using-artificial-intelligence-in-patient-care): Guidance for doctors on ethical and responsible use of AI in clinical practice.

## Consultations & Regulatory Updates

- [Consultations](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/about-us/consultations): Hub for public and stakeholder consultations on medical regulation and practice standards.
- [News & updates](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/about-us/news-and-updates): Central hub for Medical Council announcements, consultations, and regulatory guidance.

## Patient Support & Feedback

- [Royal Commission of Inquiry into Abuse in State Care](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/support/support-for-patients/royal-commission-of-inquiry-into-abuse-in-state-care-2): Medical Council's response and support resources related to Royal Commission inquiry findings.
- [Provide feedback on the notifications process](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/support/support-for-patients/making-a-notification-as-a-patient-2/provide-feedback-on-the-notifications-process): Patient feedback mechanism for improving Medical Council's notification and complaint process.
- [Other support](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/support/other-support): Support resources for practice establishment and primary care organisations.

## Optional

- [Our COVID-19 response](https://www.mcnz.org.nz/about-us/our-covid-19-response): Archive of Medical Council updates and guidance related to COVID-19 pandemic response.
